深空当铺：鉴定学 前瞻版
初级四件已完整可玩，后续会继续补初级余下四件与更高档位，更新计划共 32 件鉴定品。
当前版本：给鉴定内容增加四件新的鉴定品、四本鉴定手册、一张鉴定行会名片，以及一条「电话约考」的晋升考核路径。
新鉴定品
- 仿生指节 - 个人环境检测仪 - 腕式通讯终端 - 第九环港开港纪念币
考证玩法
- 鉴定行会名片 — 双击打开，卡面印着行会的预约号 - 晋升进度满 100% 后拨通电话约考，进度不足会被直接回绝 - 考官次日到店，带三件待鉴定物品；三件里估准两件即通过 - 考试期间不计鉴定费；考试费 150¢ 在考后收取，缴费且合格才发证书

Appraisal Studies — English
Probably Stolen: Appraisal Studies — Preview build
The four junior items are fully playable. More junior items and higher ranks will follow; the plan is 32 appraisal items in total.
Current version: four new appraisal items, four appraisal guides, one appraiser guild card, and a "book an exam by phone" path for promotion.
New appraisal items
- Cybernetic Knuckle - Personal Environment Scanner - Wrist Comm Terminal - Ninth Ring Port Commemorative Coin
The exam
- Appraiser guild card — double-click to open; the guild's booking number is printed on it - Once promotion progress reaches 100%, call to book an exam; below that you are turned down on the spot - The appraiser arrives the next day with three pieces to appraise; two correct estimates out of three and you pass - No appraisal fee is charged during the exam; the 150¢ exam fee is collected afterwards, and the certificate is issued only if you pay and pass
Requires game version 0.46D.
